description:
Manually apply a tag to specific keywords and/or pages, on top of any auto-assignment rules. Pass keywords (exact keyword strings → tags them as a keyword tag) and/or urls (exact page URLs → tags them as a page tag); at least one is required. The tag is created for the relevant type if it does not exist yet. Use remove_tag to undo. Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// tag a single keyword with the Brand tag
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","tag":"Brand","keywords":["example brand"]}
```

keywords.description: Exact keyword strings to tag. Tags them as a keyword tag.

urls.description: Exact page URLs to tag. Tags them as a page tag.

name: apply_tag
title: Apply tag
